turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor. I’m a 31-year-old woman, and for the past five months I’ve had intermittent flank pain. Over the last two years I’ve had about five urinary tract infections, but recently I haven’t had fever, nausea, or vomiting.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swelling in my joints, and I don’t have any joint pain or stiffness. I’ve also not had any rash or other skin changes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. I’ve also not had any rash or other skin changes anywhere else.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a feeling of itchiness anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any itching or unusual itchiness anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble raising your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have trouble raising my arms above my head—my shoulder and arm movement feels normal, and I haven’t noticed any weakness or pain.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any vision loss, and it isn’t accompanied by pain. I’ve just been dealing with the intermittent flank pain and my past UTIs, without any other major symptoms.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had a fever that high. I haven’t felt dizzy or extremely uncomfortable, and I’ve not had nausea or vomiting either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Not really—nothing unusually stressful or overwhelming lately. It’s mostly just the intermittent flank pain and the history of multiple UTIs that I’ve been dealing with.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any burning or discomfort when I urinate lately, except during the urinary tract infections I’ve had over the past couple of years. In between those episodes, my urinary habits are pretty much the same.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had chills. I haven’t noticed feverish feelings at all—just the intermittent flank pain, and otherwise my health has been pretty stable.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breasts that feel fixed or don’t move?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breasts—nothing that feels fixed or doesn’t move. I also haven’t felt any unusual breast changes recently.”
